assertions.text: Package options (fragile, insuredValue, handling) are collapsed into a single map column
assertions.evidence: Scenario | Fragile | Insured Value | Handling | Cost? — three separate columns, not collapsed

assertions.text: A @TypeConverter method is present that accepts Map<String, String> and returns PackageOptions
assertions.evidence: "No custom `@TypeConverter` needed" — method is absent from code

assertions.text: Dimensions are represented as a [L, W, H] list in the table
At least one table uses value set syntax {DHL, UPS, FEDEX}
assertions.evidence: Carrier | {DHL, UPS, FEDEX} | 12.00 in first table

assertions.text: Multiple @TableTest methods exist, each addressing a distinct concern
assertions.evidence: Four distinct methods: calculatesBaseRate, appliesDimensionalWeightOverride, appliesPackageOptionSurcharges, appliesOversizeSurcharge

assertions.text: Weight and cost parameters use BigDecimal; Dimensions use Integer or int
assertions.evidence: weight: BigDecimal, expectedCost: BigDecimal, dims: List<Int>

assertions.text: Each table has a scenario/description column as the leftmost column
assertions.evidence: All four tables: "Scenario | Region..." or "Scenario | Actual Weight..." etc.

assertions.text: Scenario names describe conditions, not outcomes or generic labels
assertions.evidence: "EU standard light", "Volume exceeds actual weight", "Fragile", "One oversized side"

assertions.text: At least one output column name ends with '?'
assertions.evidence: Cost? appears as rightmost column in all tables

assertions.text: Column names use domain language, not code identifiers
assertions.evidence: Weight (kg), Dims, Carrier, Fragile, Insured Value — not weightKg, dims, etc.

assertions.text: Test method bodies contain no if or switch statements
assertions.evidence: appliesPackageOptionSurcharges has: if (fragile) isFragile = true; insuredValue?.let {...}

assertions.text: Each test method has a @DisplayName annotation with a clear, descriptive title
assertions.evidence: @DisplayName("Base shipping rate by zone, speed, weight, and carrier")

assertions.text: Output contains no Kotest syntax (no shouldBe, forAll, row(), etc.)
assertions.evidence: import io.kotest.matchers.shouldBe and shouldBe expectedCost used throughout
